# `AgentSession(options.provider, [options.system], [options.onEvent], [options.memory], [options.context], [options.summarize], [options.countTokens], [options.eventLevel], [options.streaming], [...askAgentOptions])`

[External Documentation](https://github.com/rdsslab/libAgentKit/blob/main/docs/AGENT_API_GUIDE.md) 

Stateful, self-compacting conversation session from `@rdsslab/agentkit`. It owns the message history, searches it with hybrid memory (lexical always, cosine when embeddings are available), compacts at a configurable share of the context window and reports every meaningful step through a single `onEvent` callback. Use it for multi-turn endpoints; `askAgent` stays stateless.

**Notes**

- After compaction the live history is exactly `[system, summary]`; older turns are dropped and the memory index is rebuilt with only that summary. Repeated compactions do not nest summaries.
- Recall is triggered by Spanish/English recall phrasings; use `session.ask(text, { recall: false })` to skip the lookup for one turn.
- The session is process-local: an HTTP endpoint should create it inside the handler. There is no database persistence unless the host exports/imports `history` itself.
- With an Ollama provider and no explicit embedding config, `nomic-embed-text` is configured automatically; set `memory.autoEmbeddings: false` to opt out.
- `eventLevel: 'compact'` is the right default for agents that only need milestones instead of a stream of deltas.

**Agent Guidance**

- Use `AgentSession` when the user refers to previous turns ('what did we discuss', 'my name was...'); `askAgent` cannot do that without a manually rebuilt `history`.
- Do not pass `history`, `prompt`, `messages` or event callbacks to `session.ask()`: the session owns them and ignores those keys.
- Set `context.limit` (or a provider `contextLength`) so threshold warnings and compaction have a real budget; otherwise the session degrades silently.
- Collect only `done`, `error`, `compaction_*` and `recall` events unless the caller needs live streaming; enable `eventLevel: 'compact'` for endpoints.
- Do not store credentials or raw provider diagnostics in the session history or in the HTTP response; read secrets from `$_APP_VARS_`.

**Parameters**

*   `options.provider` <object|string> Provider config passed to `askAgent()` (or a preset name). `contextLength` enables threshold events and automatic compaction.
*   `options.system` <string> **Optional**. System prompt prepended to every turn. It survives compaction as part of the summary.
*   `options.onEvent` <function> **Optional**. Callback `({ type, at, turn, ...data }) => void`. Types: `recall`, `context_warning`, `context_verified`, `context_overflow`, `compaction_start`, `compaction_end`, `grounding`, `thinking`, `answer_delta`, `answer_text`, `tool`, `done`, `error`, `reset`.
*   `options.memory` <object|MemoryStore> **Optional**. Default: `hybrid defaults`. Memory config or an existing `MemoryStore`: `{ mode: 'hybrid', topK, budget, embeddings?, autoEmbeddings? }`. In-memory only; Ollama auto-configures `nomic-embed-text` unless disabled.
*   `options.context` <object> **Optional**. Context settings: `{ limit, thresholdPercent, maxSummaryChars, injectionBudgetRatio, compactionCooldownTurns, urgentCompactionPercent, verifyBandStartPercent, verifyBandEndPercent, countTokens }`.
*   `options.summarize` <function> **Optional**. Optional `async (messages) => summary`. By default the summary is deterministic and makes no extra LLM call.
*   `options.countTokens` <function> **Optional**. Optional exact counter `async ({ messages, text, system, provider, signal }) => { tokens }`. It runs only in the uncertainty band; `createOllamaTokenCounter()` is available in the `agentKit` namespace.
*   `options.eventLevel` <string> **Optional**. Default: `full`. `"full"` forwards every streaming delta; `"compact"` buffers them into a single `answer_text` event, emitted even when the provider sends no deltas.
*   `options.streaming` <boolean> **Optional**. Default: `true`. Enables streaming from the provider. Events still work when disabled.
*   `...askAgentOptions` <object> **Optional**. Every other `askAgent` option (`tools`, `toolHandlers`, `mcpServers`, `approveToolCall`, `webSearch`, `preSearch`, `capabilities`, etc.) is kept as a default for `session.ask()`. `history`, `prompt`, `messages` and callback options passed to `session.ask()` are ignored because the session owns them.

*   Returns: <AgentSession> Session instance. `ask()` resolves to the full `askAgent()` envelope.

    **Result Structure:**

    *   `ask(text, [options])` <function> Runs one turn (recall, context check, optional compaction, model call, grounding) and returns the `askAgent()` envelope. Supports per-turn `provider`, `preSearch`, `attachments`, `signal` and `recall: false`.
    *   `compact([options])` <function> Manually compacts the history into one bounded summary and purges the memory index.
    *   `reset([reason])` <function> Clears history, turn counter and memory index, then emits a `reset` event.
    *   `stats()` <function> Returns turns, history size, memory stats, token calibration and last grounding.
    *   `history / summary / turn / memory` <property> Live conversation state, current flat summary, turn counter and `MemoryStore` instance.

#### Example

```javascript

const events = [];

const session = new AgentSession({
  provider: {
    provider: 'ollama',
    model: 'llama3.2:3b',
    baseUrl: $_APP_VARS_['$_VAR_OLLAMA_URL'],
    contextLength: 8192,
  },
  system: 'Responde en espanol, breve.',
  memory: { mode: 'hybrid', topK: 5, budget: 1800 },
  context: { thresholdPercent: 90 },
  eventLevel: 'compact',
  onEvent: (event) => {
    if (event.type !== 'answer_delta') events.push(event.type);
  },
  tools: { web_search: true },
});

await session.ask('Hola, soy Ana');
const reply = await session.ask('¿Cómo me llamo?', { recall: true });

$_RETURN_DATA_ = {
  text: reply.text,
  events,
  stats: session.stats(),
};
      
```
